guidelines.weeklyTitleTherapist: Setting up Therapist weekly business hours
guidelines.weeklyTitleAnalyst: Setting up Analyst weekly business hours

weekly.p1: We strive to make you and your Clients happy. That's why setting up your availability correctly throughout the day is crucial.
weekly.therapistP2: Pick how long you need to get between clients (min. <hl>00h45m</hl> for your location). Do this first! Changing it later resets your calendar settings. Travel time becomes locked after your first booking.
weekly.therapistP3: Need a break? Grab up to {maxDaysOff} any <hl>DAYS OFF</hl> a week. You can set custom work hours for these days if you want. For other days your workday rules will apply.
weekly.therapistCard1: Schedule for all <hl>WORKDAYS</hl> will be the same. Make sure your workdays have at least one <hl>continuous window of at least 6 hours</hl> when you're available for bookings.
weekly.therapistCard2: Any other <hl>availability</hl> slots must be <hl>at least 1 hour</hl> long. Also, the <hl>breaks</hl> you take between your availability slots cannot be shorter than your chosen travel time.
weekly.therapistCard3: To keep your rating high and prevent double-booking, we automatically <hl>add travel time</hl> to every session. You'll only ever be booked for <hl>one client at a time</hl>.
weekly.analystP2: As an analyst, select whether you'll supervise <hl>in-person</hl> at the client's location, <hl>online</hl> from anywhere, or a mix of both. You can combine both types throughout your day.
weekly.analystP3: First, if you need a weekly break, select up to {maxDaysOff} <hl>DAYS OFF</hl>. You can still set custom work hours for these days if you like. For all other days, your personalized workday rules will apply.
weekly.analystCard1: For <hl>WORKDAYS</hl> your schedule will be the same. Ensure your workdays have at least one <hl>continuous 3-hour window</hl> available for supervision (in-person or online).
weekly.analystCard2: Any availability slots must be at least <hl>1 hour</hl> for in-person and <hl>30 min</hl> for online supervision. Any breaks between availability slots can be <hl>15 min</hl> or longer.
weekly.analystCard3: We prevent double-booking, but sessions can be <hl>back-to-back</hl>. Please plan your schedule to ensure you arrive on time at the client's location for in-person sessions.

guidelines.annualTitleTherapist: Setting up Therapist annual work calendar
guidelines.annualTitleAnalyst: Setting up Analyst annual work calendar

annual.intro: We strive to make you and your Clients happy. Thus, each calendar year you can select <hl>up to 56 calendar days (MO-SU) as days off</hl> to make yourself unavailable for booking.
annual.cardConsecutive: You can take a <hl>maximum of 28 consecutive days off</hl>
annual.cardInterval: The interval between any non-consecutive days off must be at least <hl>4 full calendar weeks from MO to SU</hl>
annual.cardBookings: You can select days off only in the future and only in those weeks during which you have <hl>no bookings</hl>, completed <sqCompleted></sqCompleted> or scheduled <sqScheduled></sqScheduled>
annual.cardDiscuss: While you can adjust your annual work calendar at any time, we recommend that you always <hl>discuss and agree on vacation times</hl> with your Clients
